rationale: The agent found that plate is confounded with case status, with 51 of 60 cases (85%) on plates 1-2. It showed that the plate indicator alone gives AUROC 0.81, matching the naive CV score of 0.82, so it declined to report 0.82 as a cancer signature. It recommended balancing or randomizing cases and controls across plates and run dates, which is equivalent to the key's fix.
